# Replay Baseline

`extension.js.95aa8079` is the historical patched extension baseline used by
the rc.7.13 guard-wiring replay tests, previously outside the repository.
It is code, not a research dataset. SHA256:
`95aa8079aa18dcabcce9ac94a41b63b8e44afeccc840e72bda78632ac0bdbd71`.

AGPL-3.0-or-later and the repository NOTICE apply. It is excluded from VSIX
packages, is not the current runtime, and must never be installed over it.

`extension.js.rc713-54e645da` is the historical rc.7.13 migration fixture,
SHA256 `54e645dae0087d072dcb7d3c5aacbba072e97708e64c47084628469ff7972067`.
The same license and non-installation restrictions apply.
